string.text: APB suppressor
Suppressor for APB pistol, 9x18mm caliber. Incompatible with any other firearm.
.45ACP Pistol suppressor
BLACK BOX .45ACP suppressor, made by Advanced Armament Corp. Fits most .45ACP pistols that have a threaded barrel.
PSO-1M2 Sniper optical sight

Optical scope with fixed 4x magnification. The reticle is marked for use with SVD and SVU sniper rifles. The reticle can be lit up for better use in a poorly illuminated environment. The scope can be attached to weapons with a dovetail mount.
SUSAT Assault optical sight

Optical scope developed in the United Kingdom with fixed 4x magnification. Used for precision medium and long range fire from small arms. Has backup iron sights in case of failure of the optical part. Was initially designed for use with L85.
5.7x28mm suppressor
This 5.7x28mm suppressor can be attached to FN P90 submachine gun.
GEMTECH SFN57 suppressor
Suppressor made by Gemtech for use with FN Five-seveN pistols that have a threaded barrel. Incompatible with any other firearm.
9x18mm Pistol suppressor
Suppressor for most 9x18mm pistols. Fits most weapons of the class, however, some guns might require a threaded barrel.
9x18mm «Bizon» suppressor
Suppressor designed to fit 9x18mm "Bizon" family of submachine guns.
9x19mm Pistol suppressor
Suppressor for most 9x19mm pistols. Fits most weapons of the class, however, some guns might require a threaded barrel.
9x21mm Pistol suppressor
Suppressor for 9x21mm pistol. Requires a threaded barrel.
9x39mm suppressor
Suppressor from OTs-14 "Groza" kit for 9x39mm caliber.
Hexagon 12K suppressor
Sound moderator made by Hexagon, designed for 12 caliber shotguns and carbines.
5.56x45mm suppressor
AAC M4-2000 suppressor is designed to be installed on most 5.56x45mm rifles and carbines.
PB suppressor
Front part of PB pistol, 9x18mm caliber. Incompatible with any other firearm.
TGP-V suppressor
Tactical muzzle device/suppressor for 7.62x54mmR caliber rifles. Can be installed on SVD family of rifles.
TGP-A suppressor
Tactical muzzle device/suppressor for 5.45x39mm caliber rifles. Can be installed on 5.45mm AK rifles.
